newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA SEES SLUMPING SUGAR BEET OUTPUT THIS YEAR.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA SEES SLUMPING SUGAR BEET OUTPUT THIS YEAR.

text.p: Bulgaria saw its sugar beet yield fall to half of last year's due to bad weather conditions, the Sugar Institute said on Tuesday.
"This year's sugar beet harvest will be half of last year's," said an institute expert, who declined to be named.
This year's sugar beet yield is put at 23 tonnes per hectare, down from 50 tonnes per hectare last year. Sugar content has reached 15.9 percent, he added.
"Bad weather in the spring and plant diseases have spoiled this year's beet crop," said the expert.
Last year Bulgaria harvested 174,000 tonnes from 9,300 hectares of sugar beet.

Bulgaria, which used to meet nearly 50 percent of its sugar needs with local production, now supplies its sugar-processing plants with less than 10 percent of their needs. -- Elisaveta Konstantinova, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
